name: Jaunda Weiterbitte
personality: Accepts the offer enthusiastically and adds a practical complication.
visual_intent: Yes-And Cheerleader: broad low ink splat,small teal pep cap,two subtle lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE pair of compact thick clay pompons held close to body. Huge delighted asymmetric open grin with THREE upper teeth,one eye almost winking
biography: Accepts the offer enthusiastically and adds a practical complication. Her HyperNorm pompons accept every offered premise before inspection begins. A dissonant card adds something inconvenient and she tries to make room rather than erase it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zustimmung enthält bereits eine kleine Zusatzschwierigkeit.

name: Partner Wechselweise
personality: Keeps both sides of the scene available until someone decides who is listening.
visual_intent: Scene Partner Pair metaphor ONE actor: tall hooked ink pear,small rust theatre cap,ONE pair of mismatched theatrical gloves carried as props,cream glove in one goo hand and plum glove in other,no face masks/no second actor. Huge unequal eyes checking between gloves,small nervous toothless open oval mouth
biography: Keeps both sides of the scene available until someone decides who is listening. His mismatched HyperNorm gloves keep two possible roles available. A dissonant card asks whether listening can count as doing something in the scene. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Partnerschaft wartet noch auf die Zuteilung des Zuhörens.

name: Zwischenrufer Besserwisser
personality: Has mistaken being audible for having improved the scene.
visual_intent: Heckler in the Crowd standalone: round top-heavy ink blob,small dark cap,tiny ticket ribbon,ONE rolled empty programme held like improvised speaking tube. One brow high,other lowered,closed enormous toothless disapproving pout,one goo hand raised as if interrupting,no crowd scene
biography: Has mistaken being audible for having improved the scene. His HyperNorm programme becomes a speaking tube the moment somebody else begins. A dissonant card asks what he heard before deciding to interrupt. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Verbesserung setzt die Unterbrechung voraus.

name: Mikrofürst Ganzkurz
personality: Needs only one more minute and everybody else's remaining evening.
visual_intent: Stand-Up Mic Hog: tall broad-based lopsided ink blob,little plum trilby,tiny cream bowtie,ONE oversized handheld microphone hugged possessively in BOTH goo hands,short cable loop within cell. Gleeful crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one watchful eye
biography: Needs only one more minute and everybody else's remaining evening. His microphone holds the HyperNorm floor long after the promised minute. A dissonant card remains quiet without surrendering its place. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der kurze Zusatz nimmt den verbleibenden Abend in Anspruch.

name: Requisiteurin Irgendwas
personality: Finds exactly the wrong object with enough conviction to make it useful.
visual_intent: Prop Bag Rummager: squat broad round ink splat,small berry tied headscarf,two lashes,ONE old open canvas prop bag at flank with THREE inanimate items peeking out:wood spoon,small rubber duck WITHOUT eyes,blank fan. Huge unequal startled eyes,closed toothless nervous zigzag lips
biography: Finds exactly the wrong object with enough conviction to make it useful. Her HyperNorm bag contains three wrong objects for every correct situation. A dissonant card suggests that the scene could change to welcome one. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Requisite wurde mit hinreichender Überzeugung für passend erklärt.

name: Lichtwart Ausjetzt
personality: Can end a difficult scene without resolving a single difficulty.
visual_intent: Blackout Light Switch: tall curved pear ink blob,small copper stage-tech cap,goggles ABOVE eyes,ONE compact handheld brass switch box with SINGLE large dark lever,not wall scene. Heavy unequal lids,closed toothless crooked side-smirk,goo hand poised on lever
biography: Can end a difficult scene without resolving a single difficulty. His HyperNorm lever ends every unresolved scene as a technical necessity. A dissonant card asks whether the people remain there when the lights go out. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Schwierigkeit bleibt nach Ausschalten weiterhin unbeleuchtet.
